text:
QUOTE: "A repo can declare `index_scope` in `.clew.yaml` to set those itself. If it doesn't, the default is the whole repository" and "`derive_scope` absorbs a rejected declaration into the whole-repo tier so internal callers always get a scope."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared index_scope is used when present and that no declaration, a bad shape, or unusable roots all fall through to the whole-repo scope.
